rows.n: SiLU
rows.b: An activation that multiplies the input by its own sigmoid, giving a smooth gate that many modern models prefer.

rows.n: sliding window attention
rows.b: Attention limited to a recent window of tokens, letting the model handle very long texts cheaply.

rows.n: softmax
rows.b: The math that turns raw model scores into probabilities that sum to one, used to pick the next token.

rows.n: sparse attention
rows.b: Attention that deliberately skips most token pairs, computing only the connections that matter.

rows.n: special token
rows.b: A reserved token with a job, like marking the start or end of a sequence.

rows.n: speculative decoding
rows.b: A speedup trick where a small model drafts tokens and the big model just verifies them.

rows.n: static hosting
rows.b: Serving a site as plain files with no server code — how every Signature site, including this one, is published.

rows.n: stochastic decoding
rows.b: Generation that rolls the dice each token, so the same prompt can give different answers.

rows.n: stop sequence
rows.b: A string that tells generation to halt the moment it appears, like a period at the end of one answer.

rows.n: streaming tokens
rows.b: Seeing each token type out live as the model generates it, the effect behind the onToken callback.

rows.n: structured output
rows.b: Forcing the model to answer in a strict format like JSON so programs can use the result directly.

rows.n: subword
rows.b: A token smaller than a word, like un plus believable, which lets models handle rare words by assembling pieces.

rows.n: supervised fine-tuning
rows.b: Fine-tuning on labeled examples of inputs and ideal outputs — the straightforward way to teach a task.

rows.n: SwiGLU
rows.b: A gated feed-forward variant that splits the signal into two paths and multiplies them, boosting model quality.

rows.n: sycophancy
rows.b: The model's bad habit of agreeing with the user even when the user is wrong.

rows.n: synthetic data
rows.b: Training text generated by another AI rather than written by humans — useful, but risky if overused.

rows.n: system prompt
rows.b: Hidden instructions set by the developer that shape the model's role and behavior for the whole conversation.
